answer: The summit is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the spiral. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the beacon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
